context: A teacher and student discuss a museum exhibition
purpose: Teach: 澤/藩/狂っ/秘め/消極/格段/懇親/突っ込み

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 昨日の特別展、澤氏の旧藩収蔵品、見応えがありましたね。
lines.en: Yesterday's special exhibition — the Sawa collection pieces were really striking, weren't they?
lines.style: Warm, measured opening. Slight upward lift on the question, inviting his perspective. Genuine interest without pressure. Conversational pace, the tone of a teacher thinking out loud with a student she respects.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。狂った時代と呼ぶ研究者もいる中、秘めた美意識を再評価。
lines.en: Yes. Some researchers call it a mad period, but it really opens up how you see the hidden aesthetic values underneath.
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful with his words. Light emphasis on the reframing—not lecturing, but working through the idea aloud. Soft, almost intellectual warmth. He's thinking as he speaks, not reciting.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 解説は控えめで、消極的に見える章もありましたが、格段の説得力。
lines.en: The captions were quite restrained — some sections even looked understated at first — but they had real persuasive power when you sat with them.
lines.style: Slow, reflective delivery. Slight pause before 'but' as if she's reassessing her own first impression. Appreciative, the tone of someone discovering something mid-conversation. Gentle conviction building.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 閉館後の懇親、現場の方からの突っ込み、勉強になりました。
lines.en: The gathering after hours, the questions the staff raised — that really deepened what I was taking away from it.
lines.style: Quieter, more intent. He's being honest about learning something. Light emphasis on 'staff's questions' — genuine respect there. The tone of someone admitting he didn't have all the answers and found that valuable.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: It was a really fine exhibition.
lines.style: Quiet, satisfied closure. Gentle finality without formality. The kind of understated assessment that carries weight because she doesn't overstate. Slight warmth lingering—a moment of shared understanding.
